notes: Access: direct fetch worked with no WAF/bot-block encountered (unlike some other luxury department stores in this project) - homepage, category pages, and RSC/Next.js payload all returned HTTP 200 on first try, no curl_cffi/proxy/jina sweep needed. robots.txt checked first: no Claude/AI-agent-specific disallow, only standard faceted-nav/session-param disallows. Structure: Home dept lives at /GB/en/cat/home-tech/home/ (site groups 'Home' and 'Tech' under one 'Home & tech' nav item; scoped extraction to the Home sub-tree only, ignoring all tech/appliance content). Counts sourced from the site's own embedded GraphQL 'categories' Facet (FacetEntry.count) in the Next.js RSC payload of each category page - this is the left-nav filter count the site itself computes per category, i.e. site-reported exact count (Rule 1: not a rounded/capped widget - it is the same number the on-page filter UI displays, and each category page was independently fetched to read its own facet count rather than trusting a parent rollup). Scope per project rules: Lighting (all fixture types) in full; Home accessories narrowed to genuine decor (Vases, Photo frames, Clocks, Candle holders, Mirrors, Wall art) with Cushions/Rugs & mats/Blankets & throws dropped as textiles; Dining renamed Kitchen & Dining per project convention and narrowed to tableware/glassware/serveware, with Cutlery, Bar accessories, and Table linen dropped as excluded categories; the entire top-level Kitchen facet (food prep/storage, cookware, kitchen electrical, tea & coffee accessories, kitchen linen) dropped as functional kitchen goods; Bedroom (bedding/linens) and Furniture and Outdoors (gardening/picnic/beach/outdoor cooking) top-level facets dropped in full - no lighting or mirror sub-facets exist under Outdoors, so outdoor fixtures are already captured (if present) inside the room-agnostic Lighting/Mirrors facets. Bathroom narrowed to Bathroom mirrors only as a clean leaf; Bathroom accessories flagged null (mixed genuinely-decorative items with excluded plumbing/fixture items - inspected sample titles: soap holders/trays/tissue boxes alongside toilet brushes/pedal bins/shower-curtain rings). 5 rows flagged null per Rule 'mixed roll-ups: drop, don't pad' after inspecting actual product titles on each page (sampled ~40-60 SSR-rendered titles per URL from the embedded Product objects): 'Decorative accessories' (391) mixes vases/figurines/sculptures/trays with storage crates, chess/backgammon sets and cushions; 'Ornaments' (107) mixes glass/ceramic ornaments and trinket boxes with money boxes, a duvet cover, a dinnerware set, ice cube trays and rugs; 'Dining sets' (184) mixes dinnerware/tea sets with stainless-steel cutlery sets (cutlery is explicitly excluded scope); 'Napkins & rings' (30) mixes textile linen napkins (excluded) with decor napkin rings (included) roughly evenly in sample with no way to split via the facet API; 'Bathroom accessories' (47) as above. Clean single-purpose facets (Vases, Photo frames, Clocks, Candle holders, Mirrors, Wall art, Glassware, Teacups & mugs, Plates, Bowls, Serveware, Placemats & coasters, Salt & pepper, Jugs, Teapots, Cakestands, all Lighting sub-types, Bathroom mirrors) were spot-checked via sampled product titles and found free of excluded product types (minor <5% noise e.g. one dog bowl among 58 Serveware items, one coffee grinder among 56 Teapots items, was treated as acceptable overflow, not systemic mixing, and not deducted from the site's exact facet count). Duplicate-company check: no other Selfridges entity found elsewhere in this batch; this is the sole standalone UK luxury department-store listing for the brand, home-tech/home department only (tech, fashion, beauty, food excluded as out of category scope).
